name: Symphony of Agony

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Through a combination of magic and Kuthite arts, you tend to get your way. When you succeed at an Intimidation check to coerce a creature you can freely inflict pain upon (usually by having them Restrained), you get a critical success instead, and the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against you for as long as they comply with your directives.
